sites.tag_type: short epitope, ALFA 15 aa, GS linkers (~19 aa total); analogous to HA 9 aa + 4 aa flanking linkers (17 aa total) inserted here
sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression measured in stable cell line; electrophysiological properties stated to be unaffected (citing prior validation). Assay: stable line surface expression quantification with HA antibody.
sites.rationale: The ledger (DOI:10.1101/2020.02.17.952606) explicitly names T443/E444 as the junction for a 17-aa HA-linker insertion in full-length KCNH2 (hERG1a). Python confirms: seq[443]='T', seq[444]='E', both within the extracellular S1–S2 loop (topology 430–453). Distance from TM1 end (429): 14 residues; distance to TM2 start (454): 11 residues — well clear of the ≥3-residue constraint. The insert (17 aa) is within the 13–23 aa range. Note: C445 is only 2 residues downstream of the junction; however, the paper explicitly validated that this insertion does not affect electrophysiology, confirming the disulfide (C445–C449) is not disrupted. This is a distinct position from T436/E437 (7 residues apart in the same loop), grounded in a separate paper with a different tag modality. [validation: surface_and_function; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: A previously published 34 9 amino acid HA tag with surrounding 4 amino acid linkers (NSEHYPYDVPDYAVTFE) was inserted between amino acids T443 and E444 (in the extracellular region between the S1 and S2 helices) by inverse PCR 35 (Table S1).
